name: Transport security regression guard
summary: Block high-confidence source and configuration changes that disable transport verification.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for proposed file content that detects explicit TLS certificate-verification disablement and insecure non-local registry endpoints while ignoring comments.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks high-confidence source and configuration changes that disable transport verification; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not infer the security of an entire network architecture.
It does not rewrite insecure endpoints or certificate settings.
It does not treat an inline suppression as authorization.

entrypoints.purpose: Inspect bounded proposed content for explicit transport-verification regressions.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block high-confidence source and configuration changes that disable transport verification without deferred work.
